# benthepythondev: Apify Actors, data APIs and how-to guides

> Guides for getting public web data (real estate listings, Reddit history, jobs, app reviews, tech stacks) with the benthepythondev Apify Actors and APIs, plus managed data feeds. Each guide shows the real output fields, an example and the limits.

- Apify Store profile: https://apify.com/benthepythondev

## Pages

- [Apify Actors, managed data feeds and Reddit RAG dumps](https://benthepythondev00.github.io/): Browse production Apify scrapers or request a live-tested managed feed for San Francisco rent-cut monitoring, local business research, or Reddit RAG data.
- [Reddit RAG dump — 90 days of r/X, posts + comments](https://benthepythondev00.github.io/reddit-rag-dump.html)
- [Same-day SF rent-cut monitoring and local business data feeds](https://benthepythondev00.github.io/custom.html): Live-tested managed data feeds: same-day San Francisco asking-rent cut monitoring for multifamily yield and acquisitions desks, plus local business research. Start with a source-specific sample and fixed-scope pilot.
- [San Francisco Rent Drops: One Overnight Asking-Rent Cut That Held, Built for Same-Day Delivery](https://benthepythondev00.github.io/sf-rental-price-drops.html): A live two-pass San Francisco Zumper test caught a $156 overnight price_min cut at SoMa Square, 1 Saint Francis Pl — still holding six hours later. A managed feed delivers change rows like this to Slack or Sheets the same day.
- [Berlin Tax Advisors: Eight Unique Places, Zero Leftover Emails, About $0.24](https://benthepythondev00.github.io/maps-berlin-contacts.html): A live Google Maps Email Extractor run pulled 8 Berlin tax advisors — one contact row per unique place_id, leftover-email 0 — with website-sourced email, phone, and confidence fields, for about $0.24 before discounts.
- [How to get a historical Reddit RAG pack after Pushshift (without a 4TB torrent)](https://benthepythondev00.github.io/historical-reddit-rag-pack.html): Public Pushshift is gone. Here is how to build a 90-day Reddit RAG pack past the 1,000-post cap without downloading a multi-terabyte torrent.
- [SocialBlade data in Claude and other MCP clients](https://benthepythondev00.github.io/socialblade-mcp.html): How to use SocialBlade data in Claude or Cursor, how much history you get, which platforms are covered, what a call costs, and when the official Social Blade Business API fits better.
- [How to get Zumper rental listing data (and track rent changes)](https://benthepythondev00.github.io/how-to-get-zumper-rental-listing-data.html): Export Zumper rental listings by city, property type, price and bedrooms as JSON, CSV or Excel, and watch a saved search for new listings and asking-rent changes.
- [How to Get Craigslist Real Estate Listings as Structured Data (FSBO, Rentals, Rooms)](https://benthepythondev00.github.io/how-to-get-craigslist-real-estate-listings-data.html): Turn a Craigslist housing search into one row per listing: fields, a real sample row, FSBO and rental inputs, a lead score you can check by hand, and honest limits.
- [How to get historical Reddit posts and comments by subreddit and date range](https://benthepythondev00.github.io/how-to-get-historical-reddit-posts-and-comments.html): Get a subreddit's posts and archived comments from years ago, inside a fixed UTC date window, as JSON or CSV. Fields, real output, pricing and limits.
- [How to get Reddit posts, comments and search results as structured data](https://benthepythondev00.github.io/how-to-get-reddit-posts-and-comments-data.html): Get Reddit posts and comments from a subreddit, a post URL, a username or a search query as clean JSON, CSV or Excel rows. Fields, real output, pricing and limits.
- [Jobs in Germany for foreigners: German-only listings in English, with who-can-apply checks](https://benthepythondev00.github.io/jobs-in-germany/): 256 fresh nursing, trade, engineering and IT jobs from the German Federal Employment Agency, translated into English. Each one shows whether the employer says applicants from abroad are welcome.
- [Denmark Fast-Track jobs: English openings at SIRI certified employers](https://benthepythondev00.github.io/jobs-in-denmark/): 263 English-language jobs in Denmark at 43 employers certified by SIRI for the Fast-Track scheme, rebuilt every day. Each posted salary is checked against the DKK 552,000 pay limit.
- [yfinance alternative: a watchlist's quotes, P/E and financials in CSV or Google Sheets](https://benthepythondev00.github.io/yfinance-alternative-watchlist-fundamentals-to-spreadsheet.html): Pull quote, valuation ratios and financials for a list of tickers into CSV or Google Sheets on a schedule, without installing or patching yfinance. Real input, real output, Python code.
- [How to get remote job listings you can actually apply to, from six job boards](https://benthepythondev00.github.io/how-to-get-remote-job-listings-from-six-job-boards.html): Many remote jobs are limited to one country or region. Pull listings from six boards into one dataset and keep only the ones you can apply to, with real fields, a real output row and honest limits.
- [How to Get Google Play Reviews as Structured Data](https://benthepythondev00.github.io/how-to-get-google-play-reviews-data.html): Get Google Play reviews as one row per review: rating, text, date, app version and developer reply. Real fields, real example rows and honest limits.
- [How to Get Threads User Posts Data](https://benthepythondev00.github.io/how-to-get-threads-user-posts-data.html): Export a public Threads account's full post history as rows: text, engagement counts, replies and reposts. No login, cookies or API key. Real example rows and honest limits.
- [How to get the tech stack and email provider of any website](https://benthepythondev00.github.io/how-to-get-website-tech-stack-data.html): Turn a list of company domains into one structured record per site: CMS, frameworks, payment and support tools, plus the email provider from DNS. Real fields, a real row and honest limits.
- [Custom Apify actor or scraper in 1 to 3 days, from $150](https://benthepythondev00.github.io/custom-apify-actor.html): A custom Apify actor for one website, delivered in 1 to 3 days with a CSV and JSON sample. Fixed prices: $150 up to 1,000 pages, $300 with scheduled runs, $600 with a break monitor. Check first whether one of our public actors already covers your site.
- [How do I get historical Reddit data for a date range now that Pushshift is closed?](https://benthepythondev00.github.io/reddit-historical-data-by-date-range.html): Reddit's own API caps lists at about 1,000 items and has no date search. Options compared: official API, archive dumps, Arctic Shift and a hosted archive API with a curl example.
